lines.text: The brightest planet in our night sky.  And the hottest one in the solar system.
FACT: Venus spins so slowly that one turn takes 243 Earth days. Longer than its whole year.
FACT: It spins backwards. So the Sun rises in the west.
FACT: Its thick air traps the heat. The ground is around 465°C. Hot enough to melt lead.
Standing there, the air would press on you like 900 metres of ocean.
IMAGINE: a sunrise in the west, and about two months until sunset.
Save this ride.  And tag who you'd send to Venus.
